points: Boil a full kettle. Pour the boiled water into a large saucepan with 1/2 tsp salt on high heat.
Add the rigatoni and bring back to the boil. Cook until tender, 12 mins.
Once cooked, drain in a colander and pop back in the pan. Drizzle with oil and stir through to stop it sticking together.
steps.title: Cook the Pasta

points: While the pasta cooks, peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on medium-high heat.
Once hot, add the bacon lardons. Stir-fry until golden, 4-5 mins.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw meat. Cook lardons thoroughly.

steps.title: Fry the Bacon

points: Once the bacon is cooked, drain any excess fat from the pan and pop back on the heat.
Add the garlic to the bacon and fry for 30 secs.
steps.title: Add the Garlic

points: Stir the veg stock paste, creme fraiche and water for the sauce (see pantry for amount) into the pan. Cook until piping hot, 2-3 mins.
Add the cooked pasta to the sauce and stir to combine, then remove from the heat.
steps.title: Bring on the Sauce

points: Stir the peas, pesto and two thirds of the hard Italian style cheese into your creamy pasta.
steps.title: Peas Please

points: Share your creamy bacon pesto pasta between your bowls.
Sprinkle over the remaining cheese to finish.
steps.title: Serve
